notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented starting a new riddle after a correct answer.
[*] To increase riddle variety, frequently recurring topics are now excluded. Banned topics include Love, Inspiration, Hope, Knowledge, and Imagination.
[*] Enhanced the entropy of riddle generation, resulting in greater variation at the cost of slightly reduced accuracy.
[/list]
